evidence.title: 日下舊聞考 洞天深处
evidence.excerpt_zh: 洞天深處在如意館西稍南前宇乃諸皇子所居為四所東西二街南北一街前為福園門四所之西為諸皇子肄業之所前有前垂天貺中為中天景物東宇為斯文在兹後為後天不老（圓明園册）臣等謹按洞天深處四十景之一額為皇上御書前垂天貺中天景物後天不老及如意館諸額皆世宗御書斯文在兹額恭懸至聖先師神龕上聫曰道統集成歸至徳聖功養正仰微言皆御書
evidence.summary: West and a little south of 如意館, near the 福園門: four courts where the imperial princes lived, with streets between; west of them the princes' school with 前垂天貺, 中天景物, 斯文在兹 (shrine to Confucius) and 後天不老.

evidence.title: 福園門 in front of 洞天深处
evidence.excerpt_zh: 洞天深處在如意館西稍南前宇乃諸皇子所居為四所東西二街南北一街前為福園門
evidence.summary: S01 writes 福元门. The texts write 福园门. The form 福元 is itself on a Yangshi Lei plan: S337 (三幅样式雷) reports 福元四所 on sheet 043-002 for the same place.

evidence.title: Bourgeois 1786: where things stand in the garden
evidence.excerpt_other: De-là aux maisons Européennes, qui sont comme le Jou-y-quoan, dans le terrain proprement dit Yuen-ming-Yuen, il y a plus d'un quart-d'heure de chemin. C'est dans ce quartier seul que l'on voit des jets d'eau, des gerbes, des cascades, des nappes, etc. ailleurs il n'y en a pas.
evidence.summary: Letter of October 1786. The Jesuits' house at Haidian lay a step from the south end of the park; half an hour's walk up the east side to 如意馆, then a quarter of an hour on to the European houses. Fountains only in that quarter. Fifty woodcut plates of imperial houses were in his hands. Each European house has a throne.

evidence.title: Scene 40, 洞天深处 Dongtian Shenchu
evidence.excerpt_other: Adjacent to the four dwellings was located the Ju I Kuan, or Sceptre Lodge, where the European artists, clock makers, and machinists worked in Ch'ien Lung's day.
evidence.summary: Palace School on two islands on the west, four residences of princes in a square, 如意馆 next to them. 福园门 in the outer wall just south, 300 yards directly east of 大宫门 (Benoist's letter of 1773 cited). A pasted sheet on the Official Map shows a later arrangement here.

evidence.title: Attiret: where the painters worked
evidence.excerpt_other: The Place usually assign'd us to paint in, is in one of those little Palaces above-mentioned; where the Emperor comes to see us work, almost every Day:
evidence.summary: Painters and clockmakers only among the Europeans entered. He moved under eunuch guard when he had to paint elsewhere, and says this is how he saw the garden. Emperor there ten months a year; the Jesuits had a house near the entrance. 如意馆 per S02 p.96 for Qianlong's day.

evidence.title: 圆明园“如意馆”中的西洋人
evidence.summary: Describes the missionary painters' workplace in 洞天深处 and how they entered under escort.

searched: No picture of it found in the Forty Scenes album, its 1745 woodcuts, the Bertin gouaches and the 1887 lithograph; the 20 Xiyang Lou plates; ruin photographs on Commons, at Östasiatiska museet, the Slovene Ethnographic Museum, Historical Photographs of China, the Rijksmuseum, Wellcome and in NDL's albums of about 1900; today's photographs on Commons.
